title: Prismm helps banks keep inherited money in-house | TechCrunch
summary: Meet Prismm , a startup that helps banks keep families’ money in-house after an account holder dies. Underwood and Sylla describe Prismm as infrastructure that helps banks handle what happens when a customer dies.
